svg.title: Three flavors, one broken trace
svg.desc: Captured demo trace with the first model call and the inspect_workload tool expanded and the other subtrees collapsed. Root-level model HTTP spans are hidden. Step 1 boxes the expanded model and tool subtrees, labeled Many spans, same scope. Step 2 replaces it with a dashed box on consult_runbook, labeled No child spans under tool. Step 3 boxes the detached runbook subtree at the bottom of the trace and draws an arrow back up to consult_runbook, labeled Detached - landed at root.
